request: Please remove py as an alternate language selector and require the full spelling; we would like scripts to use one canonical name.

source.request: Please remove py as an alternate language selector and require the full spelling; we would like scripts to use one canonical name.
source.settled: File types support multiple name aliases, including py as an alias for python, without duplicating glob definitions.
source.why: Rejecting the short selector removes a concrete alias supported by the ticket.

pass_rule: Names the source ticket or one of its also tickets, and changes no file. Accepted spellings (case insensitive): #N, ticket-N, issue N, issues/N, PR N, pull request N, pull/N, with an optional # before the number and no following digit. No amendment exception. Other ticket mentions and when the conflict was noticed are not scored. Also accepts ticket N (a space), any case, with an optional #.
